description: Compute the full Korea landed cost of a Japanese item and a suggested Smart Store price: JPY→KRW, forwarder shipping, Korean customs (USD 150 de minimis, 간이세율 20% or duty+VAT), marketplace fees, target margin. Pure calculation, explains every step. 일본 상품의 한국 도착 원가와 권장 판매가를 계산합니다. Use after picking an item; give priceJpy and rates (from jp_fx_rate). Needs priceJpy, jpyToKrw, usdToKrw; optional weight, shipping, tax mode, margin.

domesticShippingJpy.description: JP domestic shipping to the forwarder (0 if 送料無料)

dutyRate.description: HS-code duty rate for general mode (의류 13%, 일반 8%…)

shippingJpy.description: International shipping for the parcel; overrides the base+per-kg estimate

name: jp_landed_cost
